name: unsafe fn from_raw_fd (fd : RawFd) -> Self
rule: The `fd` passed to `from_raw_fd` must be an owned file descriptor; in particular, it must be open.
api: trait FromRawFd  : { unsafe fn from_raw_fd (fd : std::os::solid::io::RawFd) -> Self }
expression: This requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it has no observation for whether a file descriptor is owned or open.
